author: Zumaya Zumaya
text: Unprofessional, unethical and unstable! Gardner was hired by our escrow company to install a new septic system, he sold the job to West Coast Sanitation with out ever letting us know(anyone for that matter), the only way I found out is because I read the Job card that was up for 2 hours for a job that took over 2 weeks. West Coast Sanitation showed up without letting us know, and started digging up our front yard. He tore out all our sprinkler lines and demolished our driveway, stole some of our gravel at the foot of our driveway, and didn't cap all the pipes he broke. The workers told us they would repair our sprinklers and we thought they would repair the driveway as well. I called Greg to let him know, he could dump the dirt in my backyard to save money on dump fees, he was elated. When I asked him when he would repair the drive way and the sprinklers he became Irate, incensed, and indignant, raising his voice and using profanity, and proudly proclaimed, that it was in his contract, he could cause damage and not be liable.But would give me a quote to fix it! I reminded him he was saving money on the dump fees, and he said that the dumping was not in the contract. Take this as a warning read your contract, he is sneaky, stingy and psychotic. The reason he installed after we bought the house is because he got in a fight with the previous owners, harassed his wife and made her cry, making her husband mad. Never did I raise my voice to this man and he was Irate and rude, and told me that He needs to put customers in their place. Got a new septic,  but ended up with a huge head ache.  Lots more to mention  but enough said. Be Warned, stay away!!!!! A footnote, He even hassled to inspector, who was a really nice guy, who had to come out multiple times because of their errors. I think this guy needs to pump himself, he might be a little backed up! lol a little humor after a lot of headache.

author: ana b
text: DO NOT GIVE THIS GUY YOUR BUSINESS. Called and as soon as he answers, he start yelling at me. Asked a simple question and starting yelling and being very condescending. Not sure how this guy has a business with the way he treats potential customers. SPEND YOUR MONEY ELSE WHERE.

author: Keith Schulz
text: Had an emergency! Crapper was full. Called at 0700 and they answered and made an appointment that same morning. They worked hard to clean my tank I guess 3 years is a little long to go without pumping. Thank's for the quick response and reasonable price. I will be calling again much sooner next time

author: Jimmy Kim
text: I am a Realtor and needed septic cleanout & certification nearby. I found Greg and they finished so fast and did an amazing job for my sellers. My sellers and the new buyers are so happy!! Thank you!!

author: Betty Bonnie
text: Down to earth, knowledgeable and straight forward. I had a quick and friendly experience. One of our foster boys really enjoyed playing basketball with the crew. Thank you thank you!
